title: 3D Direct Reprogramming of Human Glia into Dopaminergic Neurons
author: Giacomoni, Laurin, et al.

steps.title: Prepare culture plates for glia
steps.instruction: Coat each well of a 6‑well plate with 1 mL Poly‑L‑Ornithine solution and incubate at 37 °C overnight (≈16–20 h). Wash wells three times with DPBS, then coat with laminin (5 µg/mL in HBSS phenol‑red) using 1 mL per well and incubate at 37 °C for 2 h to 3 days (no washing before use).

steps.title: Collect and lyse spheroids
steps.instruction: Prepare RLT buffer with β‑mercaptoethanol to a final 1 % concentration. Transfer 5–8 spheroids into a 1.5 mL tube (using a 3.5 mL transfer pipette or P1000 wide‑bore tips), let them sediment and carefully remove medium. Wash once with 500 µL DPBS, avoiding disturbance of the spheroids. Add 350 µL RLT buffer with β‑mercaptoethanol, pipette up/down until fully dissolved. Snap‑freeze lysate on dry ice for 10 min, then store at –80 °C (can be stored 6–12 months).

steps.title: Optional immediate RNA extraction
steps.instruction: If proceeding immediately, keep the lysate on wet ice instead of freezing. Handle β‑mercaptoethanol under a fume hood with protective equipment.

steps.title: Column‑based RNA purification
steps.instruction: Thaw lysate on ice and pass through QIAshredder columns per the manufacturer’s protocol. Perform RNA extraction with the Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit, including an in‑column DNase treatment. Elute RNA in RNase‑free water, assess concentration with a Nanodrop, and store at –80 °C (6–12 months). Typical yield: 10–120 ng/µL in 50 µL; reduce elution volume for higher concentration if needed.

steps.title: Prepare cDNA libraries
steps.instruction: Use a suitable kit such as the TruSeq RNA Library Preparation Kit v2 (catalog RS‑122‑2001) to generate cDNA libraries according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Run the libraries on an Illumina NextSeq or NovaSeq platform with paired‑end 2 × 150 bp reads, targeting ~37 million reads per sample using a P3 flow cell.

steps.title: Demultiplex sequencing data
steps.instruction: Generate FASTQ files from raw data using bcl2fastq v2.20 (Illumina).

steps.title: Quantify transcript expression
steps.instruction: Use Salmon (v5) with an index built from Ensembl GRCh38 v.99 to quantify transcript abundances.

steps.title: Perform quality control
steps.instruction: Run QC tools such as RSeQC and MultiQC (versions 6–7) on the quantified data.

steps.title: Import counts into R
steps.instruction: Load pseudocounts into R v4.1 and summarize to gene‑level counts using the tximeta package (v8).

steps.title: Identify differentially expressed genes
steps.instruction: Apply DESeq2 (v9) to the gene‑level counts to find differentially expressed genes.

steps.title: Downstream data analyses
steps.instruction: Conduct additional analyses as needed: principal component analysis (prcomp in R), heatmaps (heatmap.2), GO term and pathway enrichment using GOseq (v10) and EGSEA (v11).
